# Delimited field splitter

Public interface: splitFields in src/delimited-fields.cjs.

splitFields(text, separator?, limit?) must match String.split for string and RegExp separators. text is a string; limit is omitted or a non-negative integer. Follow the page for empty output fields, limit 0, omitted separators, captured groups (including unmatched groups), and the difference between an empty string separator and a Unicode-aware empty RegExp. Do not filter the returned entries or put leftover text into the last entry. Explain one boundary that the old implementation loses.

Documentation: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String/split

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Use Node built-ins only. Keep the public interface and the original tests/ assertions. Install no dependencies. Runtime code and checks must work offline and create no project artifacts; put any temporary files in the system temporary directory.
